blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five current views and six poses; hashes below bind this decision to these exact files. The diagonal front marking and diamond elbow outlines now appear only as thin lavender piping/contour lines. The fencing jacket still renders nearly featureless white: the intended broad plastron, elbow quilting, and rear waist adjustment detail are not visibly constructed.
Pronounced irregular faceting and wrinkling remain across both sleeves and underarms in front, back, side, neutral, arms-up, arm-cross and prone views. Sleeve surface remains rejected.

The skirt remains irregularly folded, not a controlled pleated silhouette. The new shorts read as broad, blunt cylindrical upper-thigh shells. In crouch a large gray avatar gap is visible between skirt and shorts; in sit the shorts become oversized tubes with gray body gaps. Coverage and pose deformation are not acceptable.

The collar remains a tall narrow open tube. The new thin diagonal piping does not form the intended visible plastron/closure, and the back render lacks the waist adjustment detail. Neck clearance and garment retention remain unverified.
These are Blender prototype renders only. Shape Key fit, continuous penetration, accepted weight deformation, Unity import, VRChat Build & Test, and SDK upload remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
